summary: The Helix operation now auto-fills the HelixConeAngle property from selected cone faces, applies the signed angle directly instead of flipping it by Side, and gets its own selection gate that admits circular edges and cylinder or cone faces as base geometry.

Path/Op/Gui/Selection.py: DRILLGate behaviour unchanged, only the import style of isDrillable changed
Path/Op/Gui/Selection.py: pocketselect and its gate untouched
Path/Op/Gui/Selection.py: start-point selection code untouched; only the Helix entry in the opsel map changed
